title: Sociopathic Guide to Who Matters at Work #Overemployed
description:
Coworkers are NOT friends, I learned this the hard way. Your company is NOT family, you are just another line item. So treat it as such. 

This of course is only true if you are working a soul sucking 9-5. If you love your job, don't listen to anything I say and carry on. 

But if you hate your job, reduce the hours spent through optimization. Making workplace relationships transactional is a great way to do this.
